name: no-invite-said-names
description: No calendar: the names are only said in the meeting, each more than once.
lines: Anika, can you start us off with the design review?
Sure. I've updated the onboarding screens based on the feedback from last week's testing sessions.
Thanks Anika, they look much cleaner. Declan, can you check the copy before Friday?
Yes, I'll go through it tomorrow morning.
